tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL query against the PostgreSQL database and return rows.

tools.name: execute_statement
tools.description: Execute a write SQL statement (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) against PostgreSQL.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List the tables in a PostgreSQL schema.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Return the column definitions and types for a PostgreSQL table.

tools.name: explain_query
tools.description: Return the query planner's execution plan for a SQL statement.

tools.name: list_indexes
tools.description: List the indexes defined on a PostgreSQL table.
